{{Quote|He bore a glossy ebon hide and carried a pair of battle axes, one in each hand. Most others required two hands to swing just one ax.|Sorzus Syn, ''Chronicle of Sorzus Syn''|<ref name="BOS">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
A '''battle-ax''' was a type of weapon used by [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[King/Legends|King]] [[Adas]] on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Pre-Republic era]]. Adas's oversized battle-ax was forged using [[Sith alchemy/Legends|Sith alchemy]]. Circa [[28,000 BBY]], Adas took his ax to his fellow Sith in a series of brutal conflicts, eventually uniting and consolidating the disparate nations<ref name="END" /> and [[Circle (Sith Pureblood)|tribes]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].<ref name="TOR:E">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The period of his rule became known as the "[[Reign of the Ax]]."<ref name="BOS" /> Around [[27,700 BBY]],<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> during the [[invasion of Korriban]] by the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]], the Sith were more than able to defend themselves, and Adas, refusing to tolerate their actions even in his advanced age, led his people in the vehement defense of Korriban. He participated in the punitive action, driving back the invaders with his massive ax<ref name="END" /> and [[Death/Legends|killing]] dozens of Rakatan warriors.<ref name="Hammer">{{InsiderCite|147|Hammer (short story)}}</ref>

Following the [[Discovery of Korriban]] in [[6900 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] wrote about King Adas's battle-axes in [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|chronicle]], which was later collected by [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] into his ''[[Book of Sith]]''.<ref name="BOS" /> In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Exploration Corps/Legends|ExplorCorps]] member [[Malleus|Telloti Cillmam'n]] found the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Warb Null]] on [[Nicht Ka]], an [[Ammonia/Legends|ammonia]]-washed world located on the border of the ancient [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]. After donning the armor, Cillmam'n was flooded with visions of the ancient [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] history, including the Rakatan invasion of Korriban, where he saw King Adas cutting down dozens of Rakatan warriors with his battle-ax.<ref name="Hammer" />
